This gooey, molten, chocolate mug cake is soft, rich, and bursting with flavor. Made without eggs, it’s perfect for vegetarians and anyone craving a decadent treat in just 2 minutes. For the Mug Cake 4 tbsp all-purpose flour 2 tbsp unsweetened cocoa powder 3 tbsp sugar 1/4 tsp baking powder Pinch of salt 3 tbsp milk 2 tbsp vegetable oil (or melted butter) 1/4 tsp vanilla extract 1 square of chocolate (for lava center) For the Frosting 2 tbsp powdered sugar 1 tbsp cocoa powder 1 tsp melted butter 1–2 tsp milk (adjust consistency) With a molten chocolate square in the center and a quick homemade cocoa frosting on top, this easy mug cake is guaranteed to satisfy your sweet tooth. You don’t need an oven or fancy equipment — just a mug, a microwave, and simple pantry ingredients. 🍫 Try this indulgent lava cake today, share it with your friends, and don’t forget to follow for more quick & easy eggless mug cake recipes like brownie mug cake, Oreo mug cake, and red velvet mug cake! 👉 Save this recipe, share it on TikTok, and tag us when you try it.
